none: PAS NLM-7A055D: Roman Coin: Denarius of Antoninus Pius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Denarius, possibly of Antoninus Pius (138-161), see RIC volume3 page 38 no. 102(a), mint of Rome issue of 140-143. Obverse description: Bust right, bare headed with curly hair and small beard. Obverse inscription: possibly [ANTONINVS AVG PIVS PP TRP COS III]; this reporter is especially unhappy with the suggested reading. Reverse description: Virtus standing left in crested helmet holding object aslant in right hand and spear reversed in left. Reverse inscription: VIRTV[ S AVG?]. Diameter: 16.8mm, Weight: 2.76gms, die axis: 6
